chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Watford against Liverpool, 2020. Liverpool were unbeaten in the league. Will Hughes backheels it, Troy Deeney looks up... and Ismaïla Sarr is already sprinting in behind. He races clear of everyone... and lifts it over the keeper. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. The moment Deeney looks up, Sarr runs past the last defender.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the keeper rushes out, so Sarr stays calm and lifts it over him. Two goals in six minutes!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when your teammate looks up to pass, run in behind the defence straight away!
